card.name: The digit 9 inside years
card.fires_on: The digit 9 written as part of a four-digit year, usually the second digit of 19xx or 17xx, in history passages. Also fires on the space or word just before a year.

modes.label: Digit 9 in a year
modes.description: The 9 in a year such as 1990, 1994 or 1912, mostly in historical text.

modes.label: Just before a year
modes.description: A space or small word like 'of' right before a year number.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are unrelated to years.
card.plain: It lights up on the digit 9 inside a year like 1990 or 1912 in history text.
